items.text: Composition strategy: shared composer render-qahal-homepage.ts (pure renderQahalHomepage(scene, opts)->TemplateResult assembling 4-column chrome) + thin per-scene story files (DRY)
Token-binding: shared _lib/qahal-decorator.ts exporting qahalLight/Dark/HighContrast decorators (single source of brand-binding truth across 19 stories)

Scene fixtures: typed bundles at fixtures/canonical/ + variations/ composing slices of 4 primitives modules into named scenes (rubric, member subset, stream, topology, co-steward observation, curated EPRs, external links)
Path migration: relocate 4 mock-data modules to fixtures/primitives/ with consumer import-path updates (only migration in 1B)

Capability-gating discipline in composer: reads viewerTier against rubric.externalLinkVisibility; DOM-absent (not display:none) for child/legal_steward_protected; filtered+protected-tier-marker for elder/idd; same for powerUserVisible=false
19 story files: 4 canonical (Dowell/CofC/Hardins/Wisdom-Commons) + 7 variations + 2 user-toggles + 5 capability-gating + 1 playground

Canonical stories encode storyteller named moments verbatim (sick James + Sheila soup + Gertrude check-in; Brother Cal + Romans 12 + youth retreat; etc.) at viewerTier=steward/lens=standard/powerUser=false/panel=stream
Composer behavior tests (~25 cases): chrome assembly, external-link gating per tier, power-user gating, panel routing
Scene-fixture narrative-fidelity tests (1 per canonical) preventing canonical drift; variations get lighter typed-validity assertions
Decorator tests (~5 cases): each decorator emits wrapper div with expected --el-* tokens + per-element bindings; high-contrast overrides border+state-color tokens

Verification ladder: pnpm test (~50 new) + pnpm test-storybook (19 stories a11y-clean) + sidebar structure visible + recognition test (Dowell Tuesday-morning) + distinction test (protected-tier external-link absent) — last two operator-judgment Checkpoint F gate
Pillar-level README at designed/qahal/README.md explaining composer + decorator pattern for future authors

Out of scope / deferred: Che 0.0.0.0 binding; Storybook static-build PR CI hook; behavioral .feature scenarios (Sprint 5); real backend wiring (Sprint 2+); 6 remaining UX variations (value-scanner mining); new Lit primitives; Tier 3 substrate primitives
